title: remote_write retries hammer the receiver after 429 responses
body:
### What did you do?

Our remote write receiver (Mimir) started returning HTTP 429 during an ingestion spike.

### What did you expect to see?

Prometheus backs off and retries gradually.

### What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?

All shards retry immediately and the receiver never recovers; we had to restart Prometheus.

### System information

Linux 6.8

### Prometheus version

```text
prometheus, version 3.13.4
```

### Prometheus configuration file

```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: https://mimir.example.internal/api/v1/push
```

### Logs

```text
level=WARN msg="Failed to send batch, retrying" err="server returned HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests"
```
